title: mortgage_account
description: One loan account and fixed-rate deal cycle. HomeBridge is a fictional lender. All rows are synthetic.

account_key.description: Stored join key: mortgage_id + '|' + cycle_id. Direct Lake allows no calculated columns.

cycle_id.description: Fixed-rate deal cycle within the account. It is not a scoring run.

cohort_id.description: Deal-end month (YYYY-MM). Use it to split earlier and later cohorts.

deal_end_at.description: End of the fixed-rate deal. This is not the end of the loan.

follow_on_rate_pct.description: Illustrative follow-on rate after deal end. It is not an offer.

balance.description: Outstanding balance in GBP at balance_as_of.

balance_as_of.description: Date of the balance. The generator uses the deal start.

current_payment.description: Monthly payment in GBP during the deal.

owner_id.description: Servicing adviser who owns renewal reviews.

recorded_at.description: Time the source system recorded these terms.
